TS004 assert-density

A function carries at least two assertions on average, covering its preconditions and its postconditions.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "The assertion density of the code must average a minimum of two assertions per function."
NASA P10 Rule 5: "The assertion density of the code should average to a minimum of two assertions per function. [...] Any assertion for which a static checking tool can prove that it can never fail or never hold violates this rule. (I.e., it is not possible to satisfy the rule by adding unhelpful "assert(true)" statements.)"
